input: Draft a family technology usage agreement

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Family Technology Usage Agreement
gold.taskDescription: Create a written agreement that outlines rules and expectations for how technology is used within the family household.

questions.title: How many children are covered, and what are their ages?
questions.description: Understanding the number and ages of children helps tailor rules appropriately for different developmental stages.

questions.title: Which specific devices does the agreement need to cover?
questions.description: Knowing whether the agreement covers smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, laptops, smart TVs, or all of the above shapes the scope of the document.

questions.title: What daily or weekly screen time limits do you have in mind?
questions.description: Specific time boundaries are a core component of most family tech agreements and need to be defined clearly.

questions.title: Are there specific times when devices must be off-limits?
questions.description: Examples include during meals, after a set bedtime hour, during homework, or in bedrooms overnight.

questions.title: What online safety or content restrictions need to be addressed?
questions.description: This could include social media use, talking to strangers, age-inappropriate content, or privacy rules like not sharing personal information.

questions.title: Will the agreement apply equally to parents, or only to children?
questions.description: Some families hold all members, including adults, to the same standards, while others focus the rules solely on the children.

questions.title: What consequences should the agreement spell out for violations?
questions.description: Defining what happens when rules are broken, such as temporary device removal or lost privileges, is essential for the agreement to be enforceable.
